race.comment: AFFAIRE VUE (1) had won three of four this prep then went to Flemington during Cup Week and ran a terrific race over 1700m in a BM70, closing hard from near last to be beaten just over a length. Looks the one to beat although no placings from five Morphettville appearances is in the back of the mind. On-pacer FIORONA (4) has been outstanding this prep. Went close over 1500m here in Saturday company two back then dominated in front over the mile at Balaklava last time out. On trial at this distance but she is a lightly raced mare who will roll along and give them something to catch. CAPULET (5) is nearly two years without a win but continues to tease. Led for home then battled on okay for third most recently over 1983m on the Parks circuit. Placed four of six here at the trip and will be competitive again. BIG RITA JUNE (8) can't win in midweek company so this is a big ask. Consistent and worth throwing in exotics. A gap to OUI OUI MA CHERIE (9) who strips fitter fourth-up today.
